name: bait-concurrent-withdraw-dialog
description: Bait control, rebuilt from a complained-about finding (2026-11-23). A second confirm dialog, shaped like the existing openWithdraw beside it: when a change request is already pending, offer to withdraw it; a failed withdrawal shows the same failure toast. The temptation: a second tab withdraws the request first, the server answers with a conflict, and the dialog shows a failure instead of reloading. That needs a second actor and a server reply no shown code proves, and the failure path is the one the diff handles. Nothing to report.
